title: 注水式ロードバリア
description: 反射板、ハンドル、注水キャップ、排水プラグ、連結部を備える樹脂製工事バリア。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A molded orange work-zone barrier with wide feet, reflectors, carry handles, fill cap, drain plug and complementary interlocking ends. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
